programme.title: Der Glücksbringer
programme.desc: Leider fängt das Liebesleben für den kleinen Charlie mit einem Desaster an. Als der 10-Jährige sich beim Flaschendrehen weigert, ein Mädchen zu küssen, belegt ihn die Abgewiesene mit einem Fluch: Er werde fortan Pech in der Liebe haben! So soll es kommen ... Jahre später hat der erfolgreiche Zahnarzt immer noch nicht die Richtige gefunden. Seine Ex-Freundinnen allerdings treffen alle den Mann fürs Leben – und zwar immer nach ihrem Date mit Charlie! Als das bekannt wird, stehen die Mädels auf der Suche nach Mr. Right Schlange für einen Quickie beim „Glücksbringer“. Nicht schlecht, denkt Charlie, kann man mitnehmen – bis er die tollpatschige Cam kennen lernt, eine Pinguin-Spezialistin. Als sich zwischen ihnen vorsichtig eine Liebesgeschichte anbahnt, muss Charlie den Bann brechen und den Fluch loswerden, ehe er sein Traumgirl an den nächsten verliert!

programme.title: Joe Dreck
programme.desc: Im Alter von acht Jahren wird Dummkopf Joe Dirt bei einem Ausflug zum Grand Canyon von seinen Eltern ausgesetzt. Joe ist sich der grausamen Wahrheit jedoch nicht bewußt und geht davon aus, er wäre unglücklicherweise verloren gegangen. Es folgt eine lange, rastlose Suche nach seinen Erzeugern bei der Joe so manches Abenteuer erlebt und viele skurile und interessante Personen kennenlernt.

programme.title: Joe Dreck 2: Beautiful Loser
programme.desc: In dieser Fortsetzung des Kultfilms Joe Dreck von 2001 spielt David Spade wieder den glücklosen Rock ‘n' Roll-Fan und White-Trash-Helden mit der Vokuhila-Frisur. Diesmal führt ihn seine epische Reise durch die jüngere Vergangenheit, das Herz von Amerika und durch seinen eigenen Verstand, um zurück zu seinen Lieben zu kommen.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: Einmal im Jahr will der Tyrann seine Feinde sehen. John Herod (Gene Hackman), der skrupellose Herrscher über ein kleines Städtchen im Wilden Westen, stellt sich im öffentlichen Schießwettbewerb seinen Herausforderern. Preisgeld: 100.000 Dollar! In zahllosen Duellen bringen sich die Revolverhelden gegenseitig um. Doch den heißesten Coup führt die unbekannte Schöne (Sharon Stone). Sie raucht, sie trinkt, sie trifft - und kennt offensichtlich nur ein Ziel: das Duell mit Herod...

programme.title: Jesse Stone: No Remorse
programme.desc: Tom Selleck nimmt erneut seine Rolle als Jesse Stone ein, dem schmerzgeplagten und unerbittlichen früheren Polizeichef der Kleinstadt Paradise, Massachusetts. Während seines selbstgewählten Exils nach seiner Entlassung aus dem Polizeidienst holt eine Serie zusammenhängender Morde im nahen Boston Stone aus seiner Untätigkeit zurück. Nicht lange, und er ist auf einer Spur, die ihn zu niemand geringerem als dem berüchtigtsten Gangster der Stadt führt, zu Gino Fish (WILLIAM SADLER). Basierend auf den Figuren aus den Jesse Stone-Romanen des Bestsellerautors Robert B. Parker. Mit WILLIAM DEVANE und KATHY BAKER. Jesse Stone: NO REMORSE ist eine Reise ins Paradies, die sie nicht verpassen dürfen!

programme.title: American Underdog
programme.desc: Der Film basiert auf der wahren Geschichte von Kurt Warner (Zachary Levi), der vom einfachen Supermarktangestellten zum zweimaligen NFL MVP, Super Bowl Champion und Hall of Fame Quarterback wurde. Im Mittelpunkt des Films stehen Warners einzigartige Geschichte über die Jahre der Herausforderungen und Rückschläge, die seine Ambitionen, NFL-Spieler zu werden, hätten zunichtemachen können.

programme.title: The Anderson Tapes
programme.desc: Ein Gewohnheitsverbrecher möchte direkt nach der Entlassung aus dem Gefängnis einen großen Coup durchziehen und wendet sich an ein Syndikat, das ihm einen massiven Raubzug finanzieren soll. Er hat vor, ein schickes East Side New York Apartment-Gebäude auszurauben. Er schart eine Truppe erstklassiger Diebe um sich und arbeitet an seinem geplanten Coup, ist sich dabei aber nicht bewusst, dass seine Aktionen alle aufgezeichnet werden.

programme.title: Der Mann hinter der Maske
programme.desc: Der gerissenste Söldner der British East India Company, Will Reynolds, wurde reingelegt und ist nun auf der Flucht durch die amerikanischen Kolonien. Beim Versuch, sich zu rehabilitieren und die Frau zurückzugewinnen, die er so oft belogen hat, schlüpft Will in eine neue Identität, um seinen früheren Arbeitgeber zu täuschen. Während seine Vergangenheit ihn einholt, muss Will irgendwie das Vertrauen seiner geliebten Charlotte - und auch das von Ben Franklin – gewinnen, während er gleichzeitig eine Verschwörung historischen Ausmaßes aufdecken will.

programme.title: Sheena
programme.desc: Nach dem Tod eines weißen Forscher-Ehepaars in Afrika nehmen die Eingeborenen dessen zweijährige Tochter Sheena bei sich auf. Die Kleine wächst unter großer Verehrung zu einer schönen Frau heran, der sogar die wilden Tiere gehorchen. Als der TV-Produzent Vic Casey unversehens in eine politische Intrige gerät und den Anschlag auf den König des Stammes filmt, verlieben sich beide ineinander und kämpfen nun gemeinsam gegen den Königsmörder und dessen Söldner-Armee.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp's Revenge
programme.desc: Der Film basiert auf einer wahren Geschichte und sieht einen gealterten Wyatt Earp im Mittelpunkt, der sich mit einem Reporter zusammensetzt und ihm von dem Ritt berichtet, der ihn einst zur Legende machte, als der junge Marshall zusammen mit seinen Helfern den Banditen jagte, der seine große Liebe ermordete.

programme.title: Die Tiefe
programme.desc: Ein erregender Abenteuer-Film des Bestseller-Autors Peter Benchley. Die schöne Traumfrau, Jacqueline Bisset, spielt die Frau von Nick Nolte. Während eines gemeinsamen Tauch-Urlaubes auf den Bermudas entdecken sie einen Schatz besonderer Art: In einem gesunkenen Frachter aus dem 2. Weltkrieg finden sie eine kleine Glasampulle und ein dick verkrustetes Medaillon aus dem Jahre 1714. Damit sind sie sowohl einem gut getarnten Drogenversteck als auch einem Goldschatz aus der Spanierzeit auf der Spur. Ihr Problem: Die Schätze zu bergen und dabei am Leben zu bleiben. Denn die Drogenschieber kämpfen mit allen Mitteln, zu Land wie über und unter Wasser, um ihren verbrecherischen Besitz. Robert Shaw, in der Rolle des abgebrühten Seemannes, steht ihnen in diesem Abenteuer auf Leben und Tod zur Seite.

programme.title: Quarantäne 2: Terminal
programme.desc: In einem heruntergekommenen Mietshaus in Los Angeles ist eine bizarre Seuche ausgebrochen, die niemand überlebte. außer der Seuche selbst. Nun zeigen sich auch an Bord des Fluges 318 erste Symptome. Plötzlich verwandelt die sich ausbreitende Infektion harmlose Passagiere in furchterregende, blutrünstige Killer. Gezwungen, in einem isolierten Terminal notzulanden und umstellt von bewaffneten Regierungstruppen, werden Crew und Passagiere zunehmend verzweifelter. Die einzige Frage lautet nun: Wie weit werden sie gehen, um das eigene Leben zu retten?

programme.title: Armadas e Perigosas
programme.desc: Cassidy Red é um romance western ambientado no sudoeste americano do século XIX. O filme acompanha a teimosa filha de uma prostituta que retorna à sua cidade natal em busca de vingança contra o policial corrupto que ela acredita ter assassinado seu amante.

programme.title: Børning: Rápidos e Perigosos
programme.desc: Roy é louco por carros e alimenta uma paixão pelo seu Mustang amarelo. Longe de sua filha, ele a aguarda para as férias, enquanto vai assistir a uma disputa de carros.

programme.title: O Duelo Final
programme.desc: A vingança está no sangue! Uma lutadora aposentada volta à ativa quando a irmã é vítima de um criminoso dono de um clube clandestino de luta de rua entre mulheres.

programme.title: Earthtastrophe
programme.desc: Em um flash de luz branca e quente, sem nenhum aviso, em um minuto nossa lua está lá, no outro desapareceu. Depois, um segundo clarão. E essa é a última coisa que qualquer pessoa na Terra consegue se lembrar.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: O gângster americano Erik Vasquez está planejando se tornar o rei do submundo mexicano, apenas para se encontrar fazendo inimigos tanto dos poderosos cartéis quanto de seus próprios aliados.

programme.title: Aterrissagem
programme.desc: Quando uma situação de refém surge em um avião particular com a filha de um bilionário a bordo, o major John Masters se junta ao capitão Williams para deter os terroristas e aterrar o avião.

programme.title: A Colônia
programme.desc: Forçado no submundo pela próxima era do gelo, um posto avançado de sobreviventes deve lutar para preservar a humanidade contra uma ameaça ainda mais selvagem do que a natureza.

programme.title: Sob o Domínio dos Robôs
programme.desc: À Terra foi conquistada por robôs de uma galáxia distante. Os sobreviventes estão confinados às suas casas e devem usar implantes eletrônicos, arriscando a incineração pelos robôs sentinelas se se aventurarem a sair.

programme.desc: O arqueólogo Jack continua tendo sonhos recorrentes de uma vida passada, na qual ele é o grande general Meng Yi, que jurou proteger uma princesa chamada Ok-Soo. Jack decide investigar tudo com seu amigo William.

programme.title: Terror Profundo
programme.desc: Para capturar emocionantes encontros cara a cara com os mortíferos tubarões brancos, os jovens aventureiros Josh, seu meio-irmão Jeff e a namorada de Jeff, Megan, partem para a vasta e implacável costa australiana para praticar mergulho em gaiola.

programme.title: Dead shack
programme.desc: Enquanto passam um fim de semana em uma cabana na floresta, três adolescentes descobrem que sua vizinha está alimentando sua família zumbi com hóspedes. Logo, começa uma batalha enquanto os jovens lutam para salvar a si mesmos e suas famílias.

programme.title: O marido errado
programme.desc: A suspeita de Melanie se confirma quando o irmão gêmeo idêntico de seu marido está morando com ela fingindo ser seu marido, colocando suas vidas em perigo com seus planos sinistros.

A Ederlezi recruta Milutin, um cosmonauta eslavo treinado na recém-reformada União Soviética futurista, e o acompanha com Nimani, uma androide programada para satisfazer todos os seus desejos.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Sustainability and Sport in the Jungle
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Zanzibar
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Mauritius
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: mareTV: Madeira - Portugal's sea of blossoms in the Atlantic Ocean
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The roadshow pays a final visit to Alexandra Gardens in Cardiff.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts from Clitheroe, revealing more interesting valuables. Discoveries include one of the earliest vacuum cleaners, a collection of porcelain pugs, a 17th-century gate-leg table, and a superbly painted plant pot.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the roadshow to Abergavenny in Wales. Treasures include a copy of a James Bond book bought for 50 pence, an art deco dollhouse, and a 17th-century spoon worth 2,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel's experts visit Mount Stewart in County Down, Northern Ireland, where they assess a badly damaged painting valued between 20 and 30,000, a souvenir from Laurel and Hardy, and Henry Sandon is introduced to a mug bearing his spitting image.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team returns to Mount Stewart in Northern Ireland, where their finds include a silver tea set presented to mark an officer's bravery at the battle of Trafalgar, a rare Wedgwood cup and saucer, and a teddy bear that has been in a box for 40 years.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A Victorian multi-purpose penknife, a miniature theatre, and a Japanese lacquered chest of astonishing rarity and considerable value are among the treasures discovered on a visit to Clitheroe in Lancashire.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents from Scarborough in North Yorkshire, where the artifacts include a rare surviving roll of Beatles wallpaper, the passport once belonging to the world's smallest man, and examples of some of the finest carved whales teeth.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the roadshow team are in St Ives, Cambridgeshire. They assess an early pocket calculator, a valuable jug bought for a fiver, and a traction engine arrives in full steam.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Haslar in Gosport and assess a satinwood secretaire, a radiograph of Edward VIII's hand, an Edward Lear sketch, a gold-painted bronze, a Steiff teddy, and ceremonial silverware given by Tsar Nicolas II to HMS Lion.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Wigan in Greater Manchester. Amongst the featured items are an Art Nouveau cabinet, a cache of silver buried in World War Two, and an early depiction of women's rights.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and his team of experts visit the London to Brighton Veteran Car Run, where they invite members of the public to bring along their prized possessions for expert examination.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit the RHS gardens at Wisley. Amongst the pieces under scrutiny are an early fortune teller's caravan and a credenze with a potential value of 100,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the team of experts to the Royal Horticultural Society gardens at Wisley. The treasures coming to light are a set of letters written by Lewis Carroll and a valuable carriage clock saved from a skip.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the village of Portmeirion in North Wales. Amongst the treasures brought to light are intricate 18th Century mosaics and items made by prisoners of war as gifts.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Haltwhistle in Northumberland. Amongst the discoveries made are original fittings from the Titanic's sister ship, the Olympic, a roman coin, and a letter from JRR Tolkein.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the experts are in England, Woburn Abbey in Bedfordshire. Treasured items brought to light include a rare washing bowl for beards, a portrait of a handsome cat valued at 18,000 pounds, and a Victorian bracelet that imitates a snake.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Antiques Roadshow team head for the seaside. In Hastings, the treasures uncovered are a Meissan pot, a sketch by artist Augustus John, and an unopened wedding gift from the 1920s.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits Witley Court in Worcestershire where they discover the complete cast of an early puppet theatre, a Worcester plate, a drawing by LS Lowry, and a piece of Staffordshire slipware.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the Magna Centre in Rotherham. Amongst the items brought to light are a rare clock given by Queen Victoria, a stash of silver, and some Beatles memorabilia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel explores priceless documents, from the Domesday book to the SOS telegram sent from the Titanic and some early papers charting the work of the suffragettes.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Hampton Court Palace to uncover more family heirlooms. Among the cherished valuables are a bronze figure by Auguste Rodin and an early long case clock.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A visit to Hampton Court reveals more fascinating finds for the experts. Among those viewed are a coral bracelet, a rare black wax doll, a dress designed by Vivienne Westwood and a small silver pig.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team takes the Roadshow to Hornsea on the Yorkshire coast. There they find a chastity belt dug up on a farm and an 1875 sewing machine still in use today.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Finds include an 18th Century court dress, a diamond, pearl and ruby brooch, a gift given from the Queen Mother to her Head Chef, and a tin cup that turns out to be a rare piece of silver.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts a long overdue visit to Edinburgh where, amongst the treasures, the team find an ornate Russian cigarette case and a lock of Beethoven's hair.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Included in the day's finds are a hoard of 200 typewriters, a suffragette doll dressed in clothes cut from women protestors prison uniforms, a ring worn by the daughter of Charles I.

programme.desc: Der "Königstiger T30" ist ein Harvester der Superlative.

programme.desc: Auf vielen Airports verlässt sich die Feuerwehr auf den "Panther".

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max wollen dieses Mal auf das Dach Deutschlands. Ohne Vorbereitung wollen Sie den Gipfel der Zugspitze in fast 3.000 Metern Höhe erklimmen. Den Aufstieg wollen die Abenteurer in zwei Tagen schaffen, doch im hochalpinen Gelände geht ihnen langsam die Puste aus. Zudem macht Max seine Höhenangst mit jedem Meter mehr zu schaffen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Wing Foil Surfen ist der neue Hype im Wassersport. Auf Norderney wollen Felix und Max diesen Trend im Selbstversuch ausprobieren. Die Österreicherin Evi und der Schotte John wollen heute eine Nacht in luftiger Höhe verbringen. Christian und seine Freundin Jana wollen heute mit Hilfe des Mikroabenteuer-Experten Christo Foerster von der Nordsee bis zur Ostsee laufen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: In "Bayrisch Kanada" wollen die Naturjunkies John und Evi heute mit einem Stand Up Paddle aufs Wildwasser. Die Berliner Köche Christian und Felix machen eine Fahrradtour auf dem Wasser. Und eine idyllische Ballonfahrt endet heute für Felix und Max im freien Fall. GoKart-Fahren kann jeder - Felix und Max wollen heute eine fahrende Bierkiste bauen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Die Stuttgarter Felix und Max starten ihr Mikroabenteuer diesmal direkt vor der Haustür. Mit einem Longboard wollen sie mitten auf der Schwäbischen Alb 35 Kilometer zurücklegen. Der Berliner Christian will heute mit seinem Sohn und Freundin Jana ein Floss bauen und das soll die drei am Ende auch noch trocken übers Wasser bringen. Eine idyllische Ballonfahrt endet heute für John im freien Fall.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Es ist keine leichte Aufgabe, eine riesige Metropole wie New York City am Leuchten zu halten, schließlich besteht sie aus rund einer Million Gebäude. Und da sich auch New York auf eine grünere und nachhaltigere Zukunft zubewegt, muss sich die Art und Weise, auf die der nötige Strom erzeugt wird, weiterentwickeln.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Es ist keine leichte Aufgabe, das Wasser aus den Reservoirs im Norden des Bundesstaates zu den Wasserhähnen von über 8,5 Millionen Menschen in New York City zu bringen. Fast 5 Milliarden Liter werden in der Stadt täglich benötigt, doch diese müssen zunächst gereinigt und über Tausende von Kilometern unterirdischer Tunnel transportiert werden.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Die Zwillingstürme waren Ikonen in der New Yorker Skyline. Dann veränderte sich an einem zunächst ganz normal erscheinenden Septembermorgen plötzlich alles, und die Türme waren Geschichte. Was folgte, waren mehr als zwei Jahrzehnte konkurrierender Visionen und ständiger Rückschläge, die schließlich in einem neuen Wahrzeichen der Stadt gipfelten.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Tauben und New Yorker: eine Beziehung, die bereits seit Jahrhunderten besteht. Und wie die meisten Beziehungen in New York City ist sie kompliziert. Die einen hassen die sogenannten "Ratten der Lüfte", die anderen können nicht genug von ihnen bekommen. Aber wer hat recht? Und wie viele Tauben gibt es eigentlich in der Stadt?

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Einst war es das höchste Gebäude der Welt. Auch heute noch ist seine Präsenz in der Skyline von New York City unübertroffen: das Empire State Building. Das fast einhundert Jahre alte Hochhaus ist ein komplexes Ökosystem, das sowohl innen als auch außen komplett modernisiert wurde - kein leichtes Unterfangen.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Der New Yorker Hafen ist ebenso groß wie komplex. Er beherbergt eines der kritischsten Infrastruktursysteme der USA: sechs Containerterminals, die jeden Tag Millionen Kilos an Fracht ein- und ausladen. Dieses System wird von Tausenden von Arbeitnehmern getragen - von Schlepperkapitänen über die Küstenwache bis hin zu Hafenarbeitern.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Die Skyline von New York verändert sich ständig, da die Stadt immer weiter wächst. Der Bau von Hochhäusern in New York bringt jedoch eine Reihe von Herausforderungen mit sich, wie das dichte U-Bahn-Netz und der allgemeine Platzmangel. Doch die New Yorker Bauarbeiter und Architekten haben kreative Lösungen entwickelt, um mit diesen Problemen umzugehen.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: In New York City gibt es das beste Essen - zumindest, wenn man die New Yorker fragt. Das meiste davon kommt von einem zentralen Punkt in der Bronx: dem Hunts Point Distribution Center. Jedes Jahr werden von dort aus 2 Milliarden Kilo Lebensmittel an die Restaurants, Lebensmittelgeschäfte und Bodegas der Stadt geliefert.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Die Restaurierung des Porsche 911 ist abgeschlossen. Werkstatt-Chef Thomas Lundt persönlich übernimmt die erste Probefahrt. Leistungsstark und tiefergelegt präsentiert sich auch der top überholte T1 von Tom's Garage. In Hamburg prüft Blechroller-Profi Helge, ob die Vespa-Silberpfeil straßentauglich ist. Fummelig geht’s heute bei den Minis Hamburg zu. Die restaurierte Tür muss wieder in den Wagen.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Neues Projekt, viel Arbeit. Werkstatt-Chef Thomas Lundt hat einen alten Porsche angeschleppt. Den Flying Classics aus Hamburg haben es Kultmopeds angetan. Besonders beliebt, die Ost-Marke Simson. In Tom's Roadhouse wird heute eine antike Vorkriegs-Limousine begutachtet: ein Steyr 220. Abschied bei den Minis Hamburg. Der TÜV-fertige Youngtimer wartet auf die stolze Besitzerin.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: In Tom's Roadhouse soll ein achtzigjähriger Ford ein paar PS zulegen, während die Porsche-Experten von 9elf einen äußerst seltenen Carrera 3.0 auf dem Weg zur erfolgreichen Hauptuntersuchung betreuen. Bei Il Motore steht ein Kellerfund vor der Entkernung: neuer Motor für einen alten Fiat 500. Eine top erhaltene DDR-Simson S50 findet ihren Weg zu den Spezialisten der Flying Classics.

programme.title: Die Kultschrauber
programme.desc: Der Name ist Programm: Bei Il Motore dreht sich fast alles um Antriebsmaschinen. Minustemperaturen für die luftgekühlte Rarität von 9elf: Eisstrahlung beim Carrera 3.0. In der Halle der Flying Classics wartet ein schick überholtes Kultmoped auf die Abholung. Für eine Handvoll PS mehr muss sich der betagte Ford in Tom's Roadhouse von seinem Getriebe verabschieden.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Torsten Becker arbeitet als Hufschmied. Während seiner Arbeit am Pferd muss Becker immer auf der Hut sein, denn wenn ihn das Pferd tritt, ist eine Verletzung garantiert. Prellungen, Knochenbrüche und Verbrennungen sind typische Unfallfolgen in dem Beruf. In einem Ofen werden die Eisen für die Hufe auf 1100 Grad erhitzt und dann auf dem Amboss in die richtige Form geschlagen.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Baumpfleger Steven Othold und seine Kollegen haben nicht nur einen der härtesten, sondern auch einen der gefährlichsten Jobs überhaupt. Denn die Seilkletterer müssen auf Bäume steigen und in der Baumkrone messerscharfe Sägen bedienen. Gut, dass er mit dem größten Fällkran Deutschlands einen starken Helfer zur Seite hat. Doch ein Baum zeigt sich heute besonders widerspenstig.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Jürgen Böhme und Andreas Arnold müssen sich beeilen. Ein Mobilfunkmast ist ausgefallen. Tausende Menschen müssen auf Internet und Telefon verzichten. Im schlimmsten Fall können in dem Gebiet auch keine Notrufe abgesetzt werden. Die Servicetechniker gehen auf Fehlersuche und klettern dafür den 35 Meter hohen Funkmast hoch. Auf sie muss Verlass sei – egal bei welchem Wetter.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: In Altaussee in der Steiermark arbeiten 57 Menschen im Salzbergwerk und produzieren 450.000 Tonnen Natursalz im Jahr. Im sogenannten Trockenabbau kommen nur wenige Maschinen zum Einsatz, dafür ist umso mehr Muskelkraft gefragt. Tageslicht bekommen die Bergarbeiter dabei nicht zu sehen – und sie sind nicht die Einzigen, die in völliger Dunkelheit arbeiten.

programme.title: Connections mit James Burke
programme.desc: Die Vision: Eine Zukunft mit sauberer, unbegrenzter Energie, gewonnen aus modernsten Technologien, die die Energie des Sonnenlichts in Strom umwandeln und flexibel genutzt werden können. Ein Stück weit ist diese Vision bereits Realität. Doch wie sind wir so weit gekommen? Und was haben die Kartoffel, Marie Antoinette und ein Untersee-Kabel damit zu tun?

programme.title: Connections mit James Burke
programme.desc: Alles begann mit Käfern: Als der Insekten-Freak Henry Smeathman im 18. Jahrhundert eine unerwartete Entdeckung macht, löst er einen Dominoeffekt aus, der über einige Umwege zu Augmented Reality führt. Doch die Verschmelzung der Online-Welt mit der realen Welt steht heute erst am Anfang - und wird unser Leben noch radikaler verändern.

programme.title: Connections mit James Burke
programme.desc: Die Deutschen sind verrückt nach Kaffee - und alles begann vor fast 300 Jahren in einem Leipziger Kaffeehaus. Doch dort findet sich nicht nur der Ursprung unserer Sucht nach dem heißen Wachmacher, sondern auch der Beginn einer Reise zur Entdeckung der DNA. Inzwischen haben wir die Möglichkeit, unser Erbgut aktiv zu verändern - doch wie werden wir dieses mächtige Werkzeug in Zukunft nutzen?

programme.title: Connections mit James Burke
programme.desc: Keine Suchmaschinen oder Online-Formulare mehr - menschlich aussehende künstliche Intelligenz wird der neue Torwächter zu allem Wissen der Welt sein. Sie wird aussehen wie wir, sich anhören wie wir und handeln wie wir. Und ein kleiner Schiffsbohrwurm könnte diese Entwicklung vor langer Zeit in Gang gebracht haben.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Das Universum ist scheinbar unendlich groß - und genauso verhielt es sich mit dem unstillbaren Wissensdurst von Stephen Hawking. Deshalb begibt sich der renommierte Physiker noch ein letztes Mal auf eine Reise, welche ihn zu den wichtigsten Stationen seiner Karriere und in die aufregendsten Ecken unseres Kosmos führt.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Als Physiker und Raumschiff-Kommandant unternimmt Stephen Hawking eine weitere Reise durch unser Universum. Diesmal verschlägt es ihn zur Venus, zur Sonne und bis hin zum mysteriösen Adlernebel - doch nicht immer verläuft dabei alles nach Flugplan. Die Suche nach der Weltformel und die Lösung des Fermi-Paradoxons stellen selbst für Hawking große Herausforderungen dar.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Stephen Hawking setzt seine Mission als Raumschiff-Kommandant fort. Er trifft dabei auf eine außerirdische KI und landet auf einer alternativen Erde. Die Suche nach der Weltformel bringt ihn sogar bis an den Rand des Universums. Dabei stellt Hawking auch die Frage, was darüber hinaus existiert und ob wir es nicht vielmehr mit einem "Multiversum" zu tun haben.

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Werden Menschen irgendwann die Erde verlassen, um auf dem Mars zu siedeln? Das Leben auf einem anderen Planeten wird vielfältige Anpassungen erfordern. Laut dem Evolutionsbiologen Dr. Scott Solomon könnten sich Mars-Menschen von Erden-Menschen etwa hinsichtlich der Größe von Herz und Kopf unterscheiden und auch unsere Hautpigmente könnten sich verändern.

programme.title: Neue Heimat Mars
programme.desc: Die erste Reise eines Menschen zum Mars scheint in greifbarer Nähe. Die Geschichte hinter den Technologien, die einen Besuch auf unserem Nachbarplaneten ermöglichen könnten, reicht von Nikola Tesla über die Kriegswaffen der Nazis, den Wettlauf ins All und schließlich bis hin zu den bahnbrechenden Entdeckungen der berühmten Mars-Rover.

programme.title: Mysteriöses Signal aus dem All
programme.desc: Im Green-Bank-Observatorium tief in den Bergen des US-Bundesstaates West Virginia werden rätselhafte Signale empfangen. Könnte dies ein Hinweis auf die Existenz von Leben und sogar anderen Zivilisationen im All sein? Das größte voll bewegliche Radioteleskop der Welt, mit dem Pulsare, Schwarze Löcher und andere interstellare Phänomene beobachtet werden, soll eine Antwort auf diese Frage geben.

programme.title: Klein aber fein - Der Inselflughafen Sylt
programme.desc: Der Airport der Nordseeinsel Sylt ist der nördlichste Verkehrsflughafen Deutschlands. In den Sommermonaten herrscht auf den zwei Start- und Landebahnen reger Flugbetrieb. Dann schlägt die große Stunde des kleinen, aber multifunktionalen Technikteams. Die Luftfahrt-Profis führen von der Einweisung der Maschinen, dem Be- und Entladen, der Betankung und Reinigung alles in Eigenregie durch.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Lethal Love Affair
programme.desc: Krystal Dunbar, is promoted as the youngest department head at her computer firm, after only four months. Loving her career, Krystal has convinced herself that her job is more important than a relationship. But, after an encounter with Zoey Kendricks, a beautiful and mysterious new arrival to town, Krystal's world is turned upside down. When their brief romance begins to conflict with Krystal's career aspirations, she quickly halts the relationship, sending Zoey’s emotions spiraling downward.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister—the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: He'll Still Never Let Go
programme.desc: In the wake of her abusive ex-boyfriend Karlton's disappearance, Candace seeks a fresh start. Just as she begins to open her heart to new love, Brandon, his reckless actions inadvertently expose her to danger, unaware that Karlton is silently watching. With her past closing in and her safety at risk, Candace must confront her deepest fears and fight to reclaim her freedom before Karlton's sinister plans destroy her chance at happiness.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Black Game Night
programme.desc: A group of friends prepare to attend The Blacks’ annual game night, but make a chilling discovery when the arrive to find the hosts have been brutally murdered. In their pursuit to uncover the murderer, secrets unravel and betrayals are discovered, winning no longer becomes the goal – it’s surviving.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: The Kitty Hallow Killer
programme.desc: A serial killer is on the loose in Houston killing pedophiles and rapists. When Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband, Mason, could be The Kitty Hallow Killer.

programme.title: Nothing Even Matters
programme.desc: Paroled after 5 years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by an acquaintance, Benny, and her mother. Their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder. As he falls for a woman named Bear, Travis must escape the web of secrets and lies he's trapped in, fighting for survival and the love he's found.

programme.title: Angel and Demon
programme.desc: When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle “Demon” Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mobb, they instantly become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence and threatens Angel’s once promising future.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: The Frozen Hearts: A Love Story
programme.desc: A couple attempt to find their way back to each other after a traumatic loss. Bombarded with advice and opinions from their friends and family about their relationship, will they work it out? Or fall out of love?

programme.desc: A police officer travels to Vietnam to extradite a suspect and discovers a murderer who has been targeting tourists for years.

programme.desc: In ninth-century China, an exiled assassin (Shu Qi) must choose between love or duty when she receives orders to kill a man (Chang Chen) from her past.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o protótipo de todos os carros esportivos, o Jaguar E-Type. O carro esportivo do século, seu design ainda hoje define o pulso das corridas. A História do Automóvel mostra a história da Jaguar e como o carro esportivo mais bonito do mundo foi desenvolvido a partir do carro de corrida do tipo D. O documentário inclui muitas declarações de pessoas que, quando o Tipo E estava sendo projetado.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Sempre significa, sempre radical e de alguma forma aparentemente fora deste mundo - Lamborghini. Nenhum modelo é produzido em massa, muitos modelos são únicos. Frank Sinatro disse uma vez, se você quer ser alguém, você compra uma Ferrari. Se você é alguém, você compra um Lamborghini. A história do Automóvel mostra toda a história da Lamborghini, até o mais recente e surpreendente Aventador.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Os anos sessenta e setenta, os anos dourados da Opel. A marca tradicional é elevada a sua expressão máxima. Ascona, Manta, Rekord e GT: Opel é mais do que um carro, Opel é uma atitude em relação à vida. A Opel é colorida, moderna e emocionante, produzindo um clássico após o outro. Hoje todos eles são um culto. A história do setor automotivo mostra a excelência da Opel.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia do carro - Mercedes Classe S
programme.desc: É um fenômeno, o epítome do luxo, do conforto e da segurança, pois nos anos 50 a Mercedes Classe S é a referência na classe do luxo. O modelo de status dos ricos, famosos e poderosos prevalece contra qualquer crise, mudanças sociais e competição. Cada geração da classe S mais vendida, A História do Automóvel conta a história da "classe especial".

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Se há um BMW típico, então é o BMW Série 3. É rápido, é o epítome do salão esportivo: o BMW Série 3. Desde sua estréia em 1975, a Série 3 tem sido a líder indiscutível no segmento premium. A série 3 é o carro para cada necessidade: é um carro familiar, um carro esportivo e um carro de corrida. A História do Automóvel mostra todos os modelos e a história completa da Série 3.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve'
programme.desc: Um carro de corrida icônico e um dos únicos 29 já construídos! Acompanhamos o Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve' em sua estréia no Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Se você decidir comprar o Volkswagen Polo GTI ou o Citroen's DS4 SoChic, você não precisa abrir mão da conveniência nem do desempenho. Além disso: A Nissan não se retrai quando se trata de sua marca de luxo Infiniti. Levamos o Q50 híbrido RWD para o teste.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Não apenas nas grandes cidades, é uma luta crescente por vagas de estacionamento. Levamos o BMW X6, o Citroen Cactus e o Smart forfour à cidade para descobrir como estes carros lidariam com esta situação e arredores.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: Acionamento por tracao traseira para todos
programme.desc: Os carros com tração traseira são considerados ágeis, mas também um pouco caprichosos em relação ao seu manuseio. Isto também se aplica ao Porsche GT3 e ao Smart? Além disso: a linha de modelos sedan esportivos de médio porte, a série 3 da BMW.

programme.title: A Unidade de Carros Especiais da Polícia de Dubai
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez, a unidade de carros especiais da Polícia de Dubai permite que uma equipe de TV acompanhe seus agentes em patrulha. Estes não são carros normais da polícia porque esta não é uma cidade normal.

programme.title: Um carro único: O Beradino
programme.desc: Uma "bella macchina", um belo carro - mas não projetado por mestres como Bertone ou Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen de Neuss na Alemanha construiu o Beradino à mão.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Na All-Wheel Adventure em Bad Kissingen, Alemanha, a maior exposição para offroaders na Europa, testamos o Rallye Defender e examinamos como um Jeep Wrangler regular com apenas algumas modificações poderia dobrar de preço. Além disso: como é que o pequeno Fiat Panda 4x4 nas terras altas da Islândia. Também: O Land Rover's Bowler Defender e o Volvo's 6-wheeler, o Laplander.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Acionamento em todas as rodas na neve
programme.desc: No inverno, quando as ruas ficam escorregadias, um veículo de tração integral traz muitas vantagens à medida que você ganha mais tração. Sob condições de gelo, experimentamos um dia na Áustria nevada com o Niki Schelle profissional de rali em um Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Também: por que a Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution é perfeita para a condução à deriva? E: Alemanha vs. América. Mercedes e Chrysler apresentam seus carros conceito de todas as rodas.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Os passeios pelo campo não são a única opção com um carro com tração nas quatro rodas. Você também pode se divertir muito em estradas de cascalho. Mostramos como isso acontece em um Subaru WRX STI. Também: nos anos 90, a Ford teve uma participação bem-sucedida em competições internacionais de rali com o Ford Escort RS Cosworth. programme.title: Clássicos da Arabella

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Os carros turbo de alta tecnologia dos anos 80 são reunidos no Salzburgring. E: o Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, um pequeno bimotor italiano de dois lugares com motor médio, oferece o prazer de dirigir um carro clássico a um preço de entrada baixo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Triumph 1800 Roadster de 1947 oferece espaço para 5 entusiastas do ar fresco. Mais: The Jog, o rally de carros clássico mais difícil da Europa. E: o Wolseley Stellite de 1919.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Troféu Histórico na pista de corrida de Nürburgring apresentava carros clássicos de épocas passadas do automobilismo. Também: com o M3, a BMW trouxe a tecnologia dos carros de corrida para as ruas. Era um carro versátil, adequado para a cidade, o campo e a rodovia. E também deixou uma marca impressionante na DTM. E: em 1987, o Ford Sierra RS Cosworth ensinou a sua competição de corrida o significado do medo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Carros como o Ford GT 40, o Jaguar D-Type ou o Mercedes 300 SL fizeram história na pista de corrida e agora estão batendo recordes em leilão. Um 300 SL restaurado participará do rally de automóveis clássico Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Audi Quattro - O Clássico do Rally

Allí le explica a Virginia que sabe que está muy grave y que no aceptará que sus hijas pasen su vida cuidándola. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

Entretanto, Madroño usurpa la identidad de un preso quemado y logra escapar de prisión. De inmediato va a casa de Sol para decirle que él puede probar que Reina mandó a matar a sus verdaderos padres. programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Romance
programme.desc: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts. When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn’t meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen’s "Emma."

programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen’s Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father’s fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

She leaves her cushy life in Malibu to travel to the Sierra Nevada mountains, where she pays a surprise visit to Jack (Ricky Schroder), a rugged cowboy who has no idea he’s a father. As the two struggle to bond, Willow makes a connection with a wild mustang, Bravo. Jack wants to capture and tame the magnificent horse, but Willow is convinced he needs to be free. Will the wild stallion that brought them together end up tearing them apart?

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.
